families.action: Run the Lane A exact-RC acceptance on real PostgreSQL/Redis/Identity and the customer-web Playwright journeys; emit a receipt bound to the RC tree.
Run the Lane B exact-RC acceptance on real PostgreSQL/RabbitMQ including provider reconciliation/refund paths; emit a receipt bound to the RC tree.

families.owner: Lane C (scheduling, booking, dispatch, workforce, media, operator-web)
families.action: Run the Lane C exact-RC acceptance including outbox/inbox redelivery on real RabbitMQ and operator-web journeys; emit a receipt bound to the RC tree.

families.owner: Lane D (reporting, communications, configuration, support, admin-web)
families.action: Run the Lane D exact-RC acceptance on real infrastructure and admin-web journeys; emit a receipt bound to the RC tree.
Run every mandatory CI workflow on the RC head and attach the aggregate job record.
Run secret, dependency, image and CodeQL scans on the RC head; attach findings with zero unaccepted high/critical.

families.owner: Lane E with every data-owning lane
families.action: Apply every service migration with the migration identity against a restored copy of the previous production schema; record expand/contract compatibility.
Restore every owned database from backup, measure RPO/RTO and rehearse rollback of the RC artifacts; attach observed results.
Build and publish every release image from the RC tree; record immutable sha256 digests. The deployment must reference these identical digests.
Obtain an APPROVED review on the RC pull request whose commit_id equals the RC sha, from a reviewer who did not author it.
Enable branch protection on main with required status checks, required reviews and enforce_admins; attach the protection API record.
problems: protection record must be for main
no required status checks are enforced
at least one required approving review must be enforced

families.action: Issue an explicit, time-bounded production authorization naming the RC sha, artifact manifest digest and live-money scope.
Provide the reviewed production target (cluster/account, DNS zone, TLS authority, database and broker endpoints) as references, not secrets.
Provision production secrets in the secret store and attach store references only (never values).
Complete merchant onboarding and provider verification for every enabled wallet; until then live money stays disabled.
Name distinct primary and backup incident contacts with their paging channels for the initial operating window.
Approve the initial operating window duration and numeric rollback/forward-recovery thresholds.
